additional_requirements: The binge eating occurs, on average, at least once a week for 3 months

S049.name: Eating_Large_Amount
S049.description: Eating, in a discrete period of time, an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most individuals would eat in a similar period of time under similar circumstances.
examples: Eating more than 3-4 times the amount of a typical meal within 2 hours.
Continuously eating large amounts of high-calorie snacks in addition to main meals.
Eating enough to empty a significant portion of the refrigerator or pantry at once.
Eating clearly more food than others during the same period of time.

S050.name: Loss_of_Control
S050.description: A sense of lack of control over eating during the episode (e.g., a feeling that one cannot stop eating or control what or how much one is eating).
examples: A feeling that once I start eating, I cannot stop even if I want to.
Thinking 'I shouldn't eat any more' but mechanically continuing to eat.
A feeling of helplessness that I cannot decide for myself how much to eat.
Eating as if my body is being controlled by someone else.

S051.name: Rapid_Eating
S051.description: Eating much more rapidly than normal.
examples: Swallowing food without chewing it properly.
Eating continuously and rapidly to the point where it is difficult to breathe.
Eating so urgently that there is no time to taste the food.
Eating at a speed that surprises others.

S052.name: Eating_Until_Uncomfortably_Full
examples: Eating until the stomach feels distended to the point of bursting and pain.
Eating so much that it is difficult to even stand up or move.
Continuing to eat until feeling nauseous or like vomiting.
Unable to stop eating even though it is physically uncomfortable and painful.

S053.name: Eating_Without_Hunger
S053.description: Eating large amounts of food when not feeling physically hungry.
examples: Starting to eat a large amount of food again immediately after finishing a meal.
A binge eating episode starting when not hungry at all.
Continuing to eat large amounts despite being full.
Seeking out food even when there are absolutely no physical hunger signals.

S054.name: Eating_Alone_Due_to_Embarrassment
S054.description: Eating alone because of feeling embarrassed by how much one is eating.
examples: Eating only when alone because of fear that others will think strangely of the amount eaten.
Eating secretly after family members have gone to sleep.
Pretending to eat little in front of people, then binging when alone.
Locking the door or eating in a secret place like a car to avoid being seen eating.

patient_info.stressor_event: Major change in living condition (new home, remodeling, deterioration of neighborhood or home)
patient_info.stressor: Taylor’s orderly home life was upended when a long-planned kitchen remodel became a months-long disruption, leaving appliances in the dining room, contractors coming and going, and her garden produce stacked in coolers instead of neatly preserved. During the 10 months that followed, the loss of her usual cooking and evening routines led to increasingly secretive episodes in which she bought or assembled far more food than she would normally eat, consumed it quickly while alone, and continued past comfort despite not feeling hungry. Her daily journal, usually filled with budget notes and gardening plans, began documenting repeated evenings when she felt unable to control what or how much she ate, and the secrecy felt sharply at odds with her disciplined self-image. She sought psychiatric care herself after a yoga class on mindful routines prompted her to recognize that the pattern had become persistent and clinically significant rather than a temporary reaction to renovation stress.

S049.name: Eating_Large_Amount
S049.description: Eating, in a discrete period of time, an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most individuals would eat in a similar period of time under similar circumstances.
S049.manifestation: I came in because I keep having evenings where I buy a family-size takeout order, add chips or bakery things from the store, and eat most of it myself before I even seem to register how much is gone.

S050.name: Loss_of_Control
S050.description: A sense of lack of control over eating during the episode (e.g., a feeling that one cannot stop eating or control what or how much one is eating).
S050.manifestation: Once I start, there is this awful switch that flips where I can be thinking, Taylor, put it away, and my hands still keep opening containers like I am not the one in charge.

S051.name: Rapid_Eating
S051.description: Eating much more rapidly than normal.
S051.manifestation: I eat so fast during those times that I barely taste anything, just standing at the dining room table with the microwave and boxes around me, swallowing one bite while I am already reaching for the next.

S052.name: Eating_Until_Uncomfortably_Full
S052.manifestation: I keep going until my stomach is tight and painful, and then I end up sitting very still on the couch because even walking upstairs feels uncomfortable.

S053.name: Eating_Without_Hunger
S053.description: Eating large amounts of food when not feeling physically hungry.
S053.manifestation: A lot of the time I am not physically hungry at all, because I may have had a normal dinner already, but later I still go looking through the coolers or pantry shelves like food is something I have to finish.

S054.name: Eating_Alone_Due_to_Embarrassment
S054.description: Eating alone because of feeling embarrassed by how much one is eating.
S054.manifestation: I make a point of doing it when my husband is asleep or when the contractors are gone, because I would be mortified for anyone to see the amount I can put away after acting so controlled all day at work.

additional_requirement_1.name: Additional Requirement 1
additional_requirement_1.description: The binge eating occurs, on average, at least once a week for 3 months
additional_requirement_1.manifestation: When I look back through my journal, there has barely been a week in the last several months without at least one of these nights, and most weeks it happens several times.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I have stopped inviting people over and have skipped some evening routines like yoga or gardening chores because I feel too ashamed and preoccupied after these episodes.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on since the kitchen remodel started about ten months ago.
